semiconductor_relevance: High — Ceratech Japan specializes in processing materials relevant to semiconductor manufacturing, including advanced materials like silicon carbide and gallium nitride.
summary: Ceratech Japan provides a wide range of processing services for various materials used in semiconductor applications, including fine ceramics and functional crystals. They focus on high-quality processing methods tailored to industries such as automotive and aerospace, and are expanding their capabilities in next-generation power semiconductor materials.
capabilities: Processing of fine ceramics such as aluminum nitride and silicon nitride
Polishing and micro machining services for precision components
Development of processing technologies for silicon carbide and gallium nitride

regional_presence.Japan: Ceratech Japan operates within Japan, focusing on high-quality processing services for local and international clients.
